Method of Attack: Disk wiping disguised as ransomware; encrypts and locks files but with no possible decryption, making data unrecoverable; generates random infection IDs preventing decryption; encrypts Master File Table (MFT) irreversibly; uses ransomware components to masquerade as ransomware but actually destructive
Attack Vector: Update servers of a Ukrainian accounting software maker (for NotPetya and XData)
Hijacking known ransomware families to attack Ukrainian users
Indicators of Compromise: Random infection IDs generated by NotPetya
Use of ransomware components in disk wiping malware
Distribution via Ukrainian accounting software update servers
